exposure: history of pre-eclampsia or chronic hypertension
current diagnosis of mild or severe pre-eclampsia
cohort: 250 patients diagnosed with pre-eclampsia who gave birth to live fetuses with a gestational age of 28 weeks or more between January 2009 and January 2011.
finding: Gestational age at delivery (28-37 weeks) and a diagnosis of severe pre-eclampsia were associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery.
